title: DPE Implements Special Campaign 6, aiming at saturation of swachhata in all offices
subtitle:
Campaign implementation phase runs from 2 to 31 October 2026, with focus on Swachhata, pending references and efficient office management
Efforts are underway to strengthen administrative efficiency through timely grievance disposal and systematic review of records
body_text:
The Government of India has been organizing Special Campaigns since 2021 for improving Swachhata and disposal of pending references every year. Department of Public Enterprises (DPE) has been actively participating in the Special Campaigns in the past. The Special Campaign 6 this year aims at saturation of swachhata in all offices. The Campaign also emphasises "Effective collection, segregation, and disposal of e-waste".
DPE is undertaking various activities under the Special Campaign 6. The Campaign is being undertaken in the following phases:
Preparatory Phase: 15 th September, 2026 to 30 th September, 2026; Implementation Phase: 2 nd October, 2026 to 31 st October, 2026; and Evaluation Phase: 16 th November, 2026 to 30 th November, 2026.
During the Preparatory Phase, DPE has identified the following targets/activities for the Implementation Phase:
i. Pendency and Public Grievances: Disposal of all Public Grievances.
ii. Record Management: A total of 325 files has been identified for review.
iii. Efficient Utilisation of Office Space.
iv. Swachhata and Workplace Improvement: Focused initiatives for improving cleanliness, record management, office space utilisation and the overall workplace environment.
v. Social Media Outreach:
During the Implementation Phase from 2 nd October to 31 st October, 2026, DPE is making all efforts to achieve the targets identified during the Preparatory Phase and to further strengthen Swachhata, minimise pendency, improve record management and ensure efficient utilisation of office resources.
DPE remains committed to the objectives of Special Campaign 6.
